description:
The set-completion pip calls completeSet() unguarded while the primary button checks logSet.isPending, so a double tap on a slow connection logs the set twice. Add the same client guard to the pip.

Then close the server half: a client-generated idempotency key on POST /api/sessions/:id/sets so a retried request cannot insert a second row. The retry path in T-001 makes this more likely, not less, because a user who can retry will.
title: Guard against double-logging a set
